title: Open comparison commutes with restriction
statement: Let $X,U,V$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $j:U\to X$ and $k:V\to U$ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\ge0$. Let $A_j$ be the free representable abelian sheaf, $e_j^q$ the constructed comparison, and $r_k^q$ the independently constructed global-cohomology restriction map, all as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-comparison-data]. The inclusion $k$ induces $a_k:A_{k\circ j}\to A_j$ by the free representable functor. For every $x\in\operatorname{Ext}^q_X(A_j,G)$ [def-pc-ext], one has $e_{k\circ j}^q(a_k^*x)=r_k^q(e_j^q(x))$. In particular the same canonical comparisons are compatible with restriction to every smaller open, not merely pointwise isomorphic.

proof.text: In degree zero, the inverse of the exact Ext adjunction sends mk₀(f) to the hom adjunction. Naturality of representingHomEquiv identifies precomposition with representingIso.hom with the representing sections equivalence. Consequently etaleCohomologyOverOpenEquiv on mk₀(f) is mk₀ of restrictedSectionsEquiv inverse applied to sectionsEquiv(f). Naturality in the representing object of the sheafification, free-abelian and lifted Yoneda adjunctions sends precomposition with the free sheaf map of k to G(k). Reuse the existing public sectionsEquiv_precomp theorem, preserved with its unchanged statement and proof in EtaleRepresentableSectionsNaturality when retiring the duplicate generator-coherence module, rather than redeclaring that identity.

For arbitrary open immersions j:U→X and k:V→U, evaluate the localization adjunction unit at the identity terminal objects. The localization comparison changes the unit followed by a site map to restriction along its site adjunct. Evaluate the inverse-image composition unit on the diagonal (id,id) and on (k,id); the pullback universal property identifies the two resulting maps. These equations show that the transported inverse-image unit between U and V is G(k), with the displayed localization and composition comparisons. The constant-section adjunct pullback identity then identifies the independently constructed degree-zero cohomology pullback with this same restriction. The corrections mk(id≫j)≅mk(j) commute with the map induced by k. This proves the claimed square in degree zero.

Both comparison and restriction commute with connecting maps of every short exact coefficient sequence. For comparison, apply its inverse, express it as precomposition with representingIso.hom followed by mapExtCounit, and use naturality of the short exact extension class under the counit. Restriction is an exact inverse-image Ext map followed by the natural coefficient comparison; naturality of the same extension class gives its compatibility. Exact restriction is available from its adjunction with direct image, while extension by zero is exact.

Induct on q, simultaneously for all coefficient sheaves G. Embed G into an injective I and form 0→G→I→Q→0. The Ext long exact sequence and vanishing of positive Ext into I express every degree q+1 class as the connecting image of a degree q class on Q. Associativity moves the free-sheaf precomposition across the connecting extension class. The preceding two connecting-map compatibilities and the induction hypothesis on Q prove the desired equality. The argument does not exclude empty opens, zero coefficients, or identity inclusions.
